reason: The company secured a major order worth INR 973 crores for 155mm artillery ammunition, which will materially boost its order book and future revenue recognition.
why_now: The order was announced via exchange filing on October 26, 2026.
source_headlines: SIGMA ADVANCED SYSTEMS LIMITED: SIGMA ADVANCED SYSTEMS LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 26, 2026, titled "Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirement) Regulations, 2015, Press release titled Sigma Advanced Systems Secures INR 973 crores Order for Base Bleed Units of 155mm Artillery Ammunition ".
